searchText: Hi all, what cli tool/cmd should I use to decompress the consensus-spec-tests `ssz_snappy` file to `ssz` file? My purpose is then to feed it in https://simpleserialize.com/ to inspect the actual block / state data. I have tried `szip` and `snzip` , but they don't see the consensus-spec-tests ssz_snappy files as in compressed snappy format. End up using python-snappy (https://pypi.org/project/python-snappy/) + thin wrapper script works for me.

excerpts.author: jimmychu0807
